title: lyonia ferruginea
intro: Lyonia ferruginea, commonly known as Rusty-stemmed Lyonia, is a species of flowering plant in the heath family, Ericaceae. It is a shrub that grows up to 3 meters in height and is native to the southeastern United States. The health benefits of Lyonia ferruginea include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, cough, and rheumatism, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Lyonia ferruginea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral activities.
